name: Zhao Yingqi
contribution: The son of Zhao Mo and the third ruler of the kingdom of Nanyue.

checks.lead: Zhao Yingqi (Chinese: 趙嬰齊; pinyin: Zhào Yīngqí; Jyutping: Ziu6 Jing1 Cai4; Vietnamese: Triệu Anh Tề, ? – 115 BC) was the son of Zhao Mo and the third ruler of the kingdom of Nanyue. His rule began in 122 BC and ended with his death in 115 BC.
